---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement to the list, the repo, or how profiles are added
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What Would You Like Added?

Describe the feature or improvement. Examples: a new column in the table
(like a "style" or "tech stack" tag), a GitHub Action that validates PRs
automatically, a way to browse the list by category, etc.

## Why Is It Useful?

Who would this help, contributors adding their profile, people browsing
the list for inspiration, or maintainers reviewing PRs?

## Example

If it's a table format change or a script, show what it would look like:

```markdown
| Name | GitHub Profile | README Source | Style |
|---|---|---|---|
| Example | [example](https://github.com/example) | [README](#) | Minimal |
```

## Additional Context

Anything else worth knowing, links to similar implementations elsewhere,
mockups, etc.
